attributes.name: data_model_version
attributes.markdownDescription:
The version of the data model used in the data stream.
When using `v1`:
  - The `signal` cannot be `trace`.

attributes.name: enabled
attributes.markdownDescription: Flag to enable or disable the stream integration.

attributes.name: endpoint_agent_label
id
attributes.markdownDescription: The label ID of Endpoint Agent labels.

A collection of Endpoint Agent label IDs that determines what local network data is included in the data stream. `endpointAgentLabel` and `endpointAgentTag` represent the same data. Configure only one; both are synchronized.

attributes.name: endpoint_agent_tag
id
attributes.markdownDescription: The tag ID of Endpoint Agent tags.

A collection of Endpoint Agent Tag IDs that determines what local network data is included in the data stream. `endpointAgentLabel` and `endpointAgentTag` represent the same data. Configure only one; both are synchronized.

attributes.name: endpoint_type
attributes.markdownDescription:
The type of connection used to send data to the endpoint.
**Note**: When using the `splunk-hec` 'type', the `EndpointType` must be `http`.

attributes.name: signal
attributes.markdownDescription:
The OpenTelemetry signal of the stream integration.
When using `trace` or `log`:
  - `dataModelVersion` must be `v2`.

attributes.name: stream_endpoint_url
attributes.markdownDescription:
The URL ThousandEyes sends data stream to.
For a URL to be valid, it needs to: - Be syntactically correct. - Be reachable. - Use the HTTPS protocol. - When using the `grpc` endpointType, streamEndpointUrl cannot contain paths:
    - Valid . `grpc` - `https://example.com`
    - Invalid . `grpc` - `https://example.com/collector`.
    - Valid . `http` - `https://example.com/collector`.

- When using the `http` endpointType, the operation must match the exact final full URL (including the path if there is one) to which the data will be sent. Examples below:
    - `https://api.honeycomb.io:443/v1/metrics`
    - `https://ingest.eu0.signalfx.com/v2/datapoint/otlp`

attributes.name: last_failure
attributes.markdownDescription: Last timestamp when data failed to send the stream endpoint.

attributes.name: last_success
attributes.markdownDescription: Last timestamp when data was successfully sent to the stream endpoint.

attributes.name: status
attributes.markdownDescription: The status of the stream integration. pending: No data is currently being sent to the stream endpoint. failing: Data is being sent but not successfully reaching the stream endpoint. connected: Data is being sent successfully to the stream endpoint.

attributes.name: tag_match
key
attributes.markdownDescription: The name of the tag key to match. The key is invalid if it includes characters that are not allowed by the [OpenTelemetry naming recommendations for attributes](https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/semconv/general/naming/#recommendations-for-application-developers).

attributes.name: value
attributes.markdownDescription: The value of the tag to match

A collection of tags that determine what tests are included in the data stream. These tag values are also included as attributes in the data stream metrics. Tags are invalid if the tag key includes characters that are not allowed by the [OpenTelemetry naming recommendations for attributes](https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/semconv/general/naming/#recommendations-for-application-developers).

attributes.name: test_match
domain
attributes.markdownDescription:
The domain of the test to match.
 `cea` - Cloud and Enterprise Agent
 `endpoint` - Endpoint Agent

attributes.name: id
attributes.markdownDescription: The ID of the test to match.
A collection of tests to be included in the data stream.

attributes.name: type
attributes.markdownDescription:
The type of data stream to configure.
When using `splunk-hec`:
  - `endpointType` must be `http`.
  - `exporterConfig.splunkHec.token` must contain the *Splunk HEC Token*.
